<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at release-2.1.15 -->

## What's Changed
### Bugfixes
* Confine absolute mailbox names to the session user's namespace by @netliomax25-code in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1077
* Fix off-by-one message number in MapBased getMessages(range) by @netliomax25-code in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1081
* Answer -ERR for malformed POP3 UIDL instead of closing connection by @netliomax25-code in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1082
* Decode imap literal octets as 8-bit in consumeLiteral by @netliomax25-code in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1084
* Ignore Unix-style hidden files when loading messages when running on Windows OS by @marcelmay in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1085
* Fix 12-hour parsing of APPEND date-time in CommandParser.dateTime by @netliomax25-code in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1086
* Send EXPUNGE only once to an idling session in IdleCommand by @netliomax25-code in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1089
* Synchronize user auto-creation in UserManager and createChild by @netliomax25-code in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1091
* Report whole message size in POP3 LIST and STAT by @NotAFlightRisk in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1096
* Fix IMAP SORT SIZE not including header by @marcelmay in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1099
* Fix lower-case protocol commands not recognized in Turkish locale by @vidhan843426 in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1100
### Dependencies
* Bump org.bouncycastle:bc-jdk18on-bom from 1.86.1 to 1.86.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1095
* Bump com.fasterxml.jackson:jackson-bom from 2.22.2 to 2.22.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1080, https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1098
* Bump azul/zulu-openjdk in /greenmail-docker/standalone by @marcelmay in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1101

## New Contributors
* @NotAFlightRisk made their first contribution in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1096
* @vidhan843426 made their first contribution in https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/pull/1100

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/greenmail-mail-test/greenmail/compare/release-2.1.14...release-2.1.15
